countInfo.Council_Name: Newry No. 1 (County Down) Rural District Council

source.title: Newry Reporter, 12 June 1952, p. 4 ("Notice of Result of Elections - Newry No. 1 Rural Council")
source.publisher: Newry Reporter (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: no nomination; the Returning Officer's notice names him in column 7, 'retiring Councillors deemed to be re-elected' (page image, Newry Reporter, 12 June 1952, p. 4)

note: Triennial election of the 14 electoral divisions of Newry No. 1 (County Down) rural district, one member each, polled on 5 June 1952. Hilltown was the only division contested; no nomination was received for Glen, whose retiring member was deemed to be re-elected. No nomination was received; the retiring councillor was deemed to be re-elected (Returning Officer's notice). Deemed re-elected (no nomination).
